rules.name: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
rules.description: Ensure that focused elements are not entirely hidden by other content
rules.help: When a user interface component receives keyboard focus, the component is not entirely hidden due to author-created content.

rules.name: Dragging Movements
rules.description: Functionality that uses dragging must have an alternative single pointer operation
rules.help: All functionality that uses a dragging movement for operation can be achieved by a single pointer without dragging, unless dragging is essential.

rules.name: Target Size (Minimum)
rules.description: Interactive targets must be at least 24x24 CSS pixels
rules.help: The size of the target for pointer inputs is at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels, with exceptions for inline targets, user agent control, and essential targets.

rules.name: Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
rules.description: Authentication should not rely on cognitive function tests
rules.help: A cognitive function test (such as remembering a password or solving a puzzle) is not required for any step in an authentication process unless an alternative is available.

rules.name: Consistent Help
rules.description: Help mechanisms appear in consistent locations
rules.help: If a Web page contains help mechanisms and those mechanisms are repeated on multiple pages, they occur in the same order relative to other page content.

rules.name: Redundant Entry
rules.description: Information previously entered should be auto-populated or selectable
rules.help: Information previously entered by or provided to the user that is required to be entered again is auto-populated or available for selection.

rules.name: Identify Input Purpose
rules.description: Input fields collecting user information should have appropriate autocomplete attributes
rules.help: The purpose of each input field collecting information about the user can be programmatically determined when appropriate.

rules.name: Reflow
rules.description: Content must reflow without horizontal scrolling at 320px width
rules.help: Content can be presented without loss of information or functionality, and without requiring scrolling in two dimensions.

rules.name: Non-text Contrast
rules.description: UI components and graphics must have 3:1 contrast ratio
rules.help: The visual presentation of UI components and graphical objects have a contrast ratio of at least 3:1 against adjacent colors.

rules.name: Text Spacing
rules.description: Content must be readable with modified text spacing
rules.help: No loss of content or functionality occurs when text spacing is adjusted to specified values.

rules.name: Content on Hover or Focus
rules.description: Additional content on hover/focus must be dismissible, hoverable, and persistent
rules.help: Where receiving and removing pointer hover or keyboard focus triggers additional content, the content must be dismissible, hoverable, and persistent.

rules.name: Character Key Shortcuts
rules.description: Single character key shortcuts must be configurable
rules.help: If a keyboard shortcut uses only letter, punctuation, number, or symbol characters, it can be turned off, remapped, or is only active when focused.

rules.name: Pointer Gestures
rules.description: Multipoint or path-based gestures must have single-pointer alternatives
rules.help: All functionality that uses multipoint or path-based gestures can be operated with a single pointer without a path-based gesture.

rules.name: Pointer Cancellation
rules.description: Functions must not execute on down-event of pointer
rules.help: For functionality operated through a single pointer, at least one of the following is true: no down-event, abort/undo available, up reversal, or essential.

rules.name: Label in Name
rules.description: UI components with labels must include the text in the accessible name
rules.help: For user interface components with labels that include text or images of text, the accessible name contains the text presented.

rules.name: Motion Actuation
rules.description: Functionality triggered by motion must have UI controls
rules.help: Functionality that can be operated by device motion or user motion can also be operated by user interface components.

rules.name: Status Messages
rules.description: Status messages must be programmatically determinable through role or properties
rules.help: In content implemented using markup languages, status messages can be programmatically determined without receiving focus.

rules.name: Check for Skip Navigation
rules.description: Ensure skip navigation links are present and functional
rules.help: A mechanism is available to bypass blocks of content that are repeated on multiple Web pages.

rules.name: Main Landmark Required
rules.description: Page must have exactly one main landmark
rules.help: Ensure the page has one main landmark to identify the primary content.

rules.name: Focus Indicator Visibility
rules.description: All interactive elements must have visible focus indicators
rules.help: Any keyboard operable user interface has a mode of operation where the keyboard focus indicator is visible.

rules.name: Error Identification
rules.description: Form validation errors must be clearly identified and described
rules.help: If an input error is automatically detected, the item in error is identified and described to the user in text.

rules.name: Orientation Support
rules.description: Content must not be restricted to single display orientation
rules.help: Content does not restrict its view and operation to a single display orientation unless essential.
